searchText: do we also need some early rejection on rlp decode level? like additional limits, on nested vecs or size limits in general, because a large malicious BAL can be quite expensive to decode both memory and cpu but I guess this "issue" is similar to payload decoding in general so perhaps more of an issue for the relay validation apis with untrusted access

excerpts.content:
do we also need some early rejection on rlp decode level?
like additional limits, on nested vecs or size limits in general, because a large malicious BAL can be quite expensive to decode both memory and cpu
but I guess this "issue" is similar to payload decoding in general
so perhaps more of an issue for the relay validation apis with untrusted access
